items.title: Updated Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1434 amending the MED: In force from 31 August 2026
items.summary: The 10th Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1434 from 30 June 2026 amends the Marine Equipment Directive (MED) 2014/90/EU, as was published in the Official Journal of the EU. It will come into force on 31 August 2026 and repeal the 9th Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1533.

items.title: Port State Control – CIC 2026 official questionnaire now published
items.summary: The Paris and Tokyo MoUs’ joint Concentrated Inspection Campaign (CIC) Cargo Securing will start on 1 September. The CIC questionnaire was published by the Paris MoU. This news is a followup of our news published on 29 July 2026.

items.title: The 2026 PSC CIC on cargo securing – be prepared
items.summary: This year’s Port State Control Concentrated Inspection Campaign (PSC CIC), running from 1 September to 30 November 2026, will focus on cargo securing. This news summarizes the upcoming CIC.

items.title: Now available: The July 2026 edition of the DNV class rules and standards for ship and offshore
items.summary: The July 2026 edition introduces new class notations and significant updates designed to support the maritime industry’s ongoing transition towards greater sustainability and innovation. This news highlights the key changes introduced in the new edition.

items.title: North-east Atlantic joins the expanding network of ECAs
items.summary: Recent amendments to MARPOL Annex VI adopted at MEPC 84 introduce the North-East Atlantic as a new Emission Control Area (ECA) for nitrogen oxides (NOx), sulphur oxides (SOx) and particulate matter (PM). The regulations enter into force on 1 September 2027.
